meta.description: T-2 full briefing + T-1 recap for confirmed Aerchain demo calls. Trigger logic (classify_window / needs_catchup / plan_action) mirrors the tested spec in 06-precall-intelligence-engine/trigger_scheduler.py — see that module's tests before changing the Code nodes below. Values in the 'Config' node mirror engagements/aerchain/precall_config.json; keep them in sync.

nodes.name: Config (mirrors engagements/aerchain/precall_config.json)
nodes.notes: Pending decisions from SOW Section 8: calendar_email (Decision 2) and error_alert_email (Decision 4) are placeholders — confirm with the client team before go-live.

nodes.name: Google Calendar — Get Upcoming Events
nodes.notes: Reads the shared calendar (Config.calendar_email). Window covers today through +3 days so both T-2 and T-1 classification have data.

nodes.name: Code — Classify & Plan (mirrors trigger_scheduler.py)
nodes.notes: JS re-implementation of 06-precall-intelligence-engine/trigger_scheduler.py: classify_window, needs_catchup, plan_action. Any change here must also update the Python spec + its tests, or the two will silently drift.

nodes.name: Webhook — Sub-48h Booking Created
nodes.notes: HubSpot meeting-booked / Cal.com booking webhook, per SOW Section 6 hybrid trigger. Only fires the real-time path when Config.trigger_mode = 'hybrid'.

nodes.name: Code — Check Catch-Up Window
nodes.notes: Same needs_catchup() rule as the sweep's Classify & Plan node — a booking outside the 48h window is left for the daily sweep, not briefed twice.

nodes.name: HubSpot — Get Contact by Email
nodes.notes: SOW 5.2: if the prospect isn't a HubSpot contact, the briefing still sends (next node handles a not-found result) but the writeback to precall_briefing is skipped.

nodes.name: Code — Industry Fallback Check
nodes.notes: SOW Section 10: HubSpot's industry field is commonly blank (CRM audit finding). When blank, flag needs_web_classification so the Claude prompt asks the model to classify from live web search instead of guessing — see hubspot_precall.company_to_profile for the tested equivalent.

nodes.name: Claude — Generate T-2 Briefing (web search)
nodes.notes: Model tier follows Config.claude_model_tier (SOW Decision 5: start on the default model, upgrade only if quality falls short). Prompt shape mirrors briefing_builder.build_t2_prompt — five required sections.

nodes.name: Code — Assemble Briefing HTML
nodes.notes: Mirrors briefing_builder.assemble_briefing_html — fails loud (throws) if Claude's response is missing any of the five sections, rather than mailing a half-written briefing.

nodes.name: HubSpot — Store Briefing on Contact
nodes.notes: Writes precall_briefing (property name from Config.hubspot_briefing_property) so the T-1 recap can re-read it instead of re-researching.

nodes.name: HubSpot — Read Stored Briefing
nodes.notes: T-1 reads the T-2 briefing rather than re-researching (SOW 5.1). If blank — the prospect had no HubSpot record at T-2 time — the next Code node throws rather than mailing an empty recap.

nodes.name: Code — Require Stored Briefing
nodes.notes: Mirrors briefing_builder.build_t1_prompt's ValueError on blank input.

nodes.name: Gmail — Send Error Alert
nodes.notes: SOW Decision 4 (pending): recipient is Config.error_alert_email — currently defaulted to the shared marketing@aerchain.io alias.
